page.overview:
Who is Night Knight?

Night Knight is the placeholder name of a Crystal Earth pony stallion with a blue coat, light blue mane and tail, amber eyes, and a cutie mark of a bow and arrow. He has a speaking role in the episode The Crystal Empire - Part 1.__TOC__

Night Knight shares his design with Crystal Beau, Periwinkle Pace, and S03E01 Unnamed Earth Stallion #6.

He first appears in The Crystal Empire - Part 1 during Princess Celestia's flashback of the Crystal Empire, shown to be in the forced servitude of King Sombra. Later in the episode, he is one of many Crystal Ponies having become depressed as a result of King Sombra's curse. He has a brief speaking role opposite Elbow Grease. Hearing news of the Crystal Faire lifts his spirits and returns color to his coat and mane.

In The Crystal Empire - Part 2, Night Knight has other forms of fun at the Crystal Faire, like partaking of Crystal Empire fritters and watching Rainbow Dash and Fluttershy's jousting match. He helps power the Crystal Heart at the end of the episode.
